---
title: "Assertions"
subtitle: "Fixes as separate, evidenced documents"
---

The [demo](demo/index.html) applies the first published assertion,
[`assertions/f03d-asi-latlon2d.json`](https://github.com/hypertidy/storecard/blob/main/assertions/f03d-asi-latlon2d.json),
in the browser. This page is the v0 schema, kept in the repository as
`ASSERTIONS.md`.

The idea comes from GDAL's VRT, where "assertion" is one of six properties:
SRS, geotransform, nodata, scale and offset in classic VRT; coordinates,
dimension types and names in multidimensional VRT
([VRT is: Closure, Names, Placement, Assertion, Deferral, Emission](https://www.hypertidy.org/posts/2026-11-06_vrt-six-properties/)).
